snapshot.title: MiniMax H3: Text to Video
snapshot.description: Generate video with native stereo audio directly from a text prompt using MiniMax H3, an omni-modal model that synthesizes voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and roughly 15 seconds long, with no file inputs required — just a prompt to one video output. Ideal for rapid concept visualization, social media content creation, and audio-synced storytelling.

snapshot.title: Seedance 2.5: Reference to Video
snapshot.description: Generate reference-driven videos with Seedance 2.5 by supplying up to 20 images, 6 video clips, and 6 audio clips to control character consistency, visual style, and motion rhythm in a single 4–30 second output with synchronized sound and lip-synced dialogue. Ideal for e-commerce product showcases, brand advertising, and character-driven short series.

snapshot.title: Wan 2.1 Inpainting
snapshot.description: Generate videos from start and end frames using Wan 2.1 inpainting.

snapshot.title: Wan 2.1 Fun Camera 1.3B
snapshot.description: Generate dynamic videos with cinematic camera movements using Wan 2.1 Fun Camera 1.3B model.

snapshot.title: Z-Image-Turbo: Text to Image
snapshot.description: An Efficient Image Generation Foundation Model with Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer, supports English & Chinese.

snapshot.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro: Image Edit
snapshot.description: Edit images with precision using Seedream 5.0 Pro, targeting specific regions while preserving lighting, depth, and texture. The workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 output image. Ideal for product photography edits, portrait consistency adjustments, and creating structured layouts with multilingual text.

snapshot.title: SDXL Turbo
snapshot.description: Generate images in a single step using SDXL Turbo.

snapshot.title: PixelDiT: Text to Image
snapshot.description: Input a text prompt and optional negative prompt. Generate a 1024px image using PixelDiT's VAE-free pixel diffusion transformer.

snapshot.title: TripoSplat: Image to Gaussian Splat
snapshot.description: Upload a single 2D image. Generate a high-quality 3D Gaussian splat representation with controllable density and budget for rendering.

snapshot.title: Tripo H3.1: Image to Model
snapshot.description: Upload a reference image of your object. Generate a high-detail 3D model with dense geometry and PBR-ready materials.

snapshot.title: MoGe: Perspective Geometry Estimation
snapshot.description: Upload an image to estimate its perspective geometry. Generate a 3D depth map and surface normals from the input.

snapshot.title: HY 3D 2.0 MV Turbo
snapshot.description: Generate 3D models from multiple views using Hunyuan3D 2.0 MV Turbo.

snapshot.title: Stable Audio 3.0 Medium
snapshot.description: Input a short text idea, optional duration, seed, and category. Generate stereo audio (music, SFX, or instruments) using Stable Audio 3 with optional AI-driven text expansion.

snapshot.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text to Audio
snapshot.description: Input a text prompt to generate speech, dialogue, background music, and sound effects in one audio file. Describe voices, emotion, and scene details to create multi-speaker audio up to 2 minutes.

snapshot.title: Stable Audio 1.0: Text to Audio
snapshot.description: Generate audio from text prompts using Stable Audio.

snapshot.title: ACE-Step 1.5 Music Generation AIO
snapshot.description: Input style tags and lyrics to generate a full song. The workflow uses the ACE-Step 1.5 model to produce commercial-grade music in under 10 seconds on consumer hardware.
